prerequisites: Fundamentals of Renewable Energies and Energy Storage

learning_outcomes.text: Students have a fundamental understanding of the sometimes contradictory requirements for sustainable energy supply systems and can weigh them up situationally.
Students can design different technical solutions for various energy supply systems and evaluate them based on suitable technical, economic, and ecological criteria.

Students can independently use cross-module knowledge in more complex system contexts. They carry out practical projects with support and are able to evaluate their results according to current scientific methods.
Based on their investigations, students identify open scientific questions and can formulate them.
Students can technically and scientifically discuss their research results with staff and supervisors. They write a scientific paper and defend it in a plenary session.

syllabus_topics: Brief overview of essential conversion and storage technologies
Consideration of relevant technical characteristics and limitations
assessment_rules: The graded examination consists of a Hausarbeit, which is a written scientific paper of 6 pages. This is followed by a 15-minute presentation and a maximum of 15 minutes of questioning.
